scripts.build:production: pnpm typecheck && node scripts/build-production.mjs && pnpm --dir apps/dashboard build
scripts.test:unit: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 vitest run --exclude tests/**/*.integration.test.ts --exclude tests/schema-guard.test.ts --exclude tests/http-client.test.ts --exclude tests/network.test.ts
scripts.test:sync-critical:db: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/*.integration.test.ts tests/schema-guard.test.ts tests/http-client.test.ts tests/network.test.ts --exclude tests/api.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:sync-critical:api: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/api.integration.test.ts --testNamePattern "auto-queues|initial sync|retry path|latest light sync|detailed sync health|stored proxy|sync runs|page credentials|admin verify|inline proxy|sync monitor|sync block|manual block controls|recent sync requests|sync request limits|system health"
